summary: First-pass full E2E test of AussieBack MVP. All 16 backend pytest cases passed (estimator math, lead create/persist, admin auth, leads list/search/filter, status update incl. 404, stats, CSV export). Frontend landing page, full 3-step estimator funnel (visa select, balance/earnings modes, live preview, validation, submission with persisted lead), and admin dashboard (protected route, wrong/correct login, stats, leads table, search filter, status filter dropdown, CSV download, lead detail modal, sign out) all working as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: compute_refund hardcodes the 12% SG rate and tax rates as module constants — fine for MVP, but consider moving to env/config or DB for future regulatory updates without redeploying.

POST /api/leads accepts client-supplied estimated_refund in the payload but correctly overrides via server-side compute_refund. The field in LeadCreate could be made Optional to make the contract clearer (currently required even though ignored).

Background task dispatch_lead_integrations runs after response but is synchronous (requests.post, twilio sync client) — under load this could block worker threads. Consider async clients or a queue if traffic grows.
Lead model status is typed LeadStatus; raw docs returned from /admin/leads come straight from Mongo (no Pydantic validation) — if data drift occurs, the frontend could break. Low risk for MVP.
FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in favor of lifespan handlers in Starlette/FastAPI ≥0.95 — works for now but worth migrating.
CORS allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per spec (browsers ignore credentials with wildcard). Acceptable for stateless Bearer-token API but worth noting.
test_credentials: admin@aussieback.com / Admin@123 (verified working, seeded on startup as expected)
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed leads (e.g. TEST_Backpacker via API, TEST_E2E via UI). No cleanup performed; safe to keep for repeat admin-dashboard testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_aussieback_api.py — run `pytest backend/tests/test_aussieback_api.py -v` from /app. It uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Test seed data is left in DB with TEST_ prefix on first_name/email so it can be searched in admin dashboard. Stub integrations (Twilio/Resend/Webhook) log `[STUB]` lines in backend log on every POST /api/leads — this is expected.
